title: Beatrice d'Aragona to Eleonora d'Aragona, Buda, 2 May 1486 (DECODE R1143)

steps.what: Extracted five exact dates, recipients and shelfmarks from cached DECODE metadata; web reader could not open live DECODE page.
Used existing user-authorized DECODE cookie to acquire all 18 images. R1143 has repeated photographs with decipherment slips moved.
Located MDE III nos. 10 and 12 for both 1482 letters, III no. 75 for May 1486, IV supplement no. 45 for March cipher and III no. 54 for its closing.

Matched dates, clear wording, cipher boundaries and R1143 manuscript slips to older readings. Rendered print confirms italics and March Virtus/Fortis/M. markers. No exhaustive key verification claimed.
Entry split from beatrice1482 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): R1143 is two months after R1142, which encloses a new cipher; the two are not shown to share a key.

outcome.method_basis: The letter carries contemporary decipherment slips laid over the cipher, and MDE III (1877) no. 75 prints the reading; slips and print were matched to the DECODE images and no key was applied.
outcome.notes: Milanese support for Ippolito against Cardinal Ascanio's envoy; Andriolo to come. Six photographs show three written pages, two of them twice with the slips moved. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from beatrice1482.
